JU5 WAS RUN AND IS STILL UNMEASURABLE, and the reason is a fixture rather than a build. There is no `advanceQuest` in the harness (`grep -n questAdvance game/src/harness/api.js` returns nothing), so I drove the game's own `Journal.write()`. It wrote ZERO new entries: every one of `states/ui-journal.json`'s five quests is already at the last journal index its definition contains. The re-capture is 19 -> 19, 0 removed, 0 altered, 0 added — which proves the rendered entries are STABLE across a re-render and does NOT prove append-only under advance. Scored fail-closed. The fix is one line in `tools/ui/t4-r2-critic-ju5.mjs` (open a fresh quest first) or a fixture with a quest left mid-chain, and it is the cheapest outstanding check in this piece.

THE THREE FALSE FAILURES MY OWN FIRST TWO PASSES PRODUCED, stated here because they are the same class of defect as the ones I am judging. (1) The `ui-journal` fixture restores `mode: 'inventory'`, so my first `menu` press CLOSED a screen and every ring check downstream cascaded off it. (2) I passed a string array to `openContainer`, which spreads into a character map, and recorded a transfer failure that was mine. (3) `two_hand`'s hold gate is measured in WALL-CLOCK MILLISECONDS, so a harness `stepFrames(20)` is a ~3 ms hold and my '20-frame hold' never reached the 200 ms gate. All three were caught by re-running rather than by reasoning, and the third is written into RI-UIX10 §B as trap I2 so the next critic does not pay for it.
